verdict.rationale: Dropbox documents official SDKs for Swift, .NET, Java, JavaScript, Objective-C and Python, and its first-party GitHub repos show the official JavaScript and Python SDKs, with a usage example and stated runtime support. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality, and repo-level evidence for the Swift, .NET, Java and Objective-C SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
